What Korvo is

Not a chatbot. Not just a workspace.
A decision engine.

Chat gives you an answer. Korvo helps you define the job before the answer is written.

A workspace stores your material. Korvo connects each conclusion back to the material that supports it.

A decision engine keeps the plan, challenge, evidence, and final call together so another person can inspect them later.

The workflow

Capture → Structure → Plan → Execute → Preserve

1

Capture

Drop files, notes, and pasted text into one project. Keep the messy source material together.

2

Structure

Korvo indexes the project locally so you can search and retrieve the right context.

3

Plan

It identifies the goal, assumptions, missing context, and analysis steps. You approve the plan before execution.

4

Execute

Produce briefs and syntheses grounded in evidence selected from your workspace, with citations back to the source.

5

Preserve

Keep the conclusion, source links, model details, revisions, and unresolved questions together.

Built for

People who have to show their work.

Investors

Run diligence across decks, financials, founder notes, calls, and market research. Pressure-test the case before it reaches partner review.

Founders

Turn board material, customer evidence, and scattered strategy notes into a plan with explicit assumptions.

Operators

Synthesize reports and project context into an actionable brief without losing the evidence behind it.

Researchers

Organize a literature set, compare claims, and produce cited synthesis from the source material.

Privacy and models

Local-first workspace. Transparent model traffic.

Your workspace, files, local index, and decision history stay on your machine. When using a cloud model, selected context goes directly to your provider under your own key and agreement. Or connect Ollama and nothing leaves your machine at all.

Local-first architecture

Files, the local SQLite index, notes, plans, and decision history reside strictly on your device. Korvo never holds your workspace data on its servers.

BYOK cloud traffic transparency

Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google directly with your own key. Prompts and selected context go to that provider under their terms. Korvo never proxies, inspects, or logs them.

100% on-device option

Connect Ollama for full offline operation on local models. No prompt, project context, or document data leaves your machine.

Data rights, zero lock-in

Export outputs to PDF and Markdown. Delete local workspace data anytime. Your files, notes, and generated outputs remain yours.

Medha

Models generate. Medha measures. You decide.

Medha is Korvo’s on-device quality-measurement layer. It tests retrieval with deterministic metrics such as recall, MRR, and nDCG without model calls or private corpus content leaving the device. It does not generate answers or claim that an answer is true.

Questions before you download

The practical details.

Do I need my own API keys?

Yes for cloud models. Add a key from OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google and requests go directly from your device to that provider. API usage is separate from Korvo Pro; a practical individual-use budget is often about $5–$30 per month, but the actual amount depends on the model, document volume, and how often you run multi-model critique.

What actually leaves my machine?

Your workspace files, notes, local SQLite index, plans, and decision history reside strictly on your device and are never uploaded to Korvo servers. Cloud-model prompts and selected context go directly to your chosen provider under your own key and agreement. When you explicitly run an MCP tool, its arguments and required authentication go directly to the server you connected. Those requests are governed by the provider or server’s terms; Korvo does not proxy, log, or inspect them.

What if I do not want to use a cloud model?

Connect a local model through Ollama. Model requests then stay on your machine, so no prompt or project context is sent to a cloud-model provider. Model quality and hardware requirements depend on the model you choose.

Is my work locked in?

Your workspace is stored on your device and remains yours. Pro can export outputs to PDF and Markdown, and you can delete local workspace data at any time. Korvo does not claim rights over your files, notes, or generated outputs.

Can Korvo connect to MCP tools?

Yes. Connect the built-in Superhuman Mail preset or add a custom MCP server under Settings → Integrations → AI Tools. You can inspect discovered tools and run them manually with JSON arguments. Chat models cannot autonomously execute MCP tools; mutating or unannotated tools require an Allow once confirmation.

The two-model critique remains beta while real-project dogfood and blinded evaluation continue. Medha’s synthetic baselines are available; human-labelled release evaluation is still in progress. Access is rolling out in small batches, with early-access delivery targeted within seven days of purchase.

科尔沃是什么

不是聊天机器人。 不仅仅是一个工作空间。一个决策引擎。

聊天给你答案。 Korvo 在写下答案之前帮助您定义工作。

工作区存储您的材料。 科尔沃将每个结论与支持它的材料联系起来。

决策引擎将计划、挑战、证据和最终决定放在一起，以便其他人稍后可以检查它们。

工作流程

捕获→结构→计划→执行→保留

1

捕获

将文件、注释和粘贴文本拖放到一个项目中。 将杂乱的源材料放在一起。

2

结构

Korvo 在本地对项目进行索引，以便您可以搜索和检索正确的上下文。

3

Plan

它确定了目标、假设、缺失的上下文和分析步骤。 您在执行之前批准该计划。

4

执行

根据从您的工作空间中选择的证据制作摘要和综合，并引用来源。

5

保存

将结论、源链接、模型详细信息、修订和未解决的问题放在一起。

专为

必须展示自己作品的人。

投资者

对平台、财务、创始人说明、电话会议和市场研究进行尽职调查。 在案例提交合作伙伴审核之前对其进行压力测试。

创始人

将董事会材料、客户证据和分散的策略说明转化为具有明确假设的计划。

运营商

将报告和项目背景综合成可操作的摘要，同时不丢失其背后的证据。

研究人员

组织文献集，比较权利要求，并从源材料中生成引用的综合。

Do I need my own API keys?

对于云模型是的。 添加来自 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 Google 的密钥，请求将直接从您的设备发送至该提供商。 API 的使用与 Korvo Pro 是分开的；实际的个人使用预算通常约为每月 5-30 美元，但实际金额取决于模型、文档量以及运行多模型批判的频率。

What actually leaves my machine?

您的工作区文件、注释、本地 SQLite 索引、计划和决策历史记录严格驻留在您的设备上，并且永远不会上传到 Korvo 服务器。 云模型提示和选定的上下文根据您自己的密钥和协议直接发送到您选择的提供商。 当您显式运行 MCP 工具时，其参数和所需的身份验证将直接发送到您连接的服务器。 这些请求受提供商或服务器条款的约束； Korvo 不会代理、记录或检查它们。

What if I do not want to use a cloud model?

通过 Ollama 连接本地模型。 然后，模型请求会保留在您的计算机上，因此不会将提示或项目上下文发送到云模型提供商。 模型质量和硬件要求取决于您选择的模型。

Is my work locked in?

您的工作区存储在您的设备上并始终属于您。 Pro 可以将输出导出为 PDF 和 Markdown，并且您可以随时删除本地工作区数据。 Korvo 不主张对您的文件、笔记或生成的输出的权利。

Can Korvo connect to MCP tools?

是的。 连接内置的 Super human Mail 预设或在“设置”→“集成”→“AI 工具”下添加自定义 MCP 服务器。 您可以检查发现的工具并使用 JSON 参数手动运行它们。 聊天模型无法自主执行MCP工具；变异或未注释的工具需要“允许一次”确认。
